coordinateSystem.value: FairyGUI top-left coordinates measured in the 750x1334 BagLikeBattlePage, converted to Cocos centered coordinates with xCocos=x+width/2-375 and yCocos=667-(y+height/2)

objective.value: deploy powered hero gears, protect the 500 HP player camp, and clear all scheduled enemies in five automatic rounds

runtimeEnemyBaseHp.note: BattleTrunkChapterVo overrides the generic configuration. Mainline rounds therefore end when scheduling is complete and no enemy units remain; the enemy camp is not a damage objective.

uiHierarchy.value: persistent top HUD and battlefield, with BagLikeOperComp preparation controls sliding out during battle and returning after a round

refresh.normalRefreshRequirement: enough in-battle coin after the first normal refresh

weightedDrops.staticCondition: static batches only while challengeTimes <= 1, except forever-static chapters 1001/1002/1006/1007
weightedDrops.slotSampling: independent weighted RewardMgr.getRewards call per draw id; repeats are allowed

placement.mode: manual drag from ChooseCom candidate container into the 7x5 backpack grid
placement.candidateOnValidDrop: remove from ChooseCom and TAKE_ON_BRICK / setBrick or setGrid
placement.occupiedDrop: merge first; otherwise place the dragged gear and return every fully displaced overlapping gear to ChooseCom without destroying it
placement.placedGearInvalidDrop: clear the old footprint and return the placed gear to ChooseCom

merge.mode: drag one recipe partner over another in either ChooseCom or the occupied backpack grid
merge.resultBehavior: consume the dragged item and update the target item in place to the configured result id
merge.footprintRendering: piece view width and height equal shape columns and rows multiplied by the 100-pixel grid size; every truthy shape cell is rendered

starFeatures.trigger: final damage caster hero id matches scope

skill.runtimeDisconnect: card copy says participating in a defeat, but BATTLE_MONSTER_DIE carries only one killerId and the consumer has no assist list

skill.selectionPolicy: the highest H02-star-qualified row in each RG_H02_abl02 or RG_H02_abl03 group enters the pool and applies to later-created H02/H07 units
skill.runtimeDisconnect: the barrage card and orphan Buff groups describe 3/4-second ATK_SPD +30000 states, but the reachable ADD_SKILL chain casts for 2/3 seconds; 2001_6 removes its configured 3500-ms seventh behavior at cast completion

skill.selectionPolicy: star-qualified RG_H03 groups enter independently and selected ADD_PASSIVITY_SKILL/ADD_SKILL rows apply only to later-created H03/H08 units
skill.runtimeDisconnect: the star-8 transform card says incoming vulnerability, but version-18 applies target-side outgoing DMG_INC=3000; the laser audio key skill_jiguang has no recovered asset and is not replaced with invented audio

starPassives.counterattackBase: resistance-adjusted floating damage before floor and shield
starPassives.counterattackOrder: before original-hit shield and HP application; CounterAttack status cannot recurse

starFeatures.evaluationOrder: before dodge, critical and regular damage

skill.passiveSelectionPolicy: the highest H04-star-qualified row in each RG_H04_abl02 or RG_H04_abl03 group enters the pool and applies to later-created H04/H09 units
skill.runtimeDisconnect: card copy says max-HP healing, but version-18 4001_bh1/4001_bh2 use generic attack-scaled heal and floor the result

starFeatures.selectionBehavior: selectable once and recorded in buff-times map
starFeatures.reason: version-18 addEffective has no handler and no external row-id/times consumer

skill.replacementPolicy: selected replacement applies to later H11 casts through SkillConfig.group ZL_1101; a living friendly target is still required
last selected replacement in SkillConfig.group LY_1201 wins
skill.damageOrder: dodge before critical; dodge and forced-critical short-circuit critical RNG

configuredLastBounceExplosion.reason: BounceBullet resets child bouncelTimes before last_missile selection and copies the parent counter afterwards

skill.replacementPolicy: highest account-star-qualified RG_H13_abl02 row enters the pool; the selected replacement applies to later H13/H09 launches
skill.hitPolicy: initial hit plus nearest unvisited enemies strictly inside bounceRange; atk_ins 1000 compounds once per follow-up segment

spawners.phaseLifetime: The GameTimer quarter-lap tween continues through preparation and battle and is not reset by BAGLIKE_BATTLE_ROUND_START; preparation contacts keep occupied-side delay but ShowNodeCom suppresses worker progress outside BATTLE.
spawners.triggerRule: Each occupied core side triggers its entire orthogonally connected component; a component touching N sides receives N triggers per lap.
spawners.displayedRateFormula: powerPerTrigger * coreContactCount / ((lapSeconds + occupiedSideDelaySeconds * coreContactCount) / productivity) / workerPowerMax

regularDamage.formula: max(1, floor(attack * effectRatio/10000 * hitFactor/10000 * critFactor/10000 * damageCoefficient/10000))
regularDamage.bossModifier: source BOSS_DMG_INS is added only when target is BossUnit

timing.projectile: Copies attack/source identity at launch, travels along its initial direction, and survives caster death; a dead single target causes no hit while an area projectile can still resolve at its fixed impact point.

sameFrameConsequences: scheduled monsters participate in collision and action in their creation frame
bullets created by hero/monster actions advance in the later bullet pass of that frame
queued unit disposal precedes bullet updates

randomDomains.nativePosition: Math.random for schedule spawn Y followed by factory X and Y jitter

knownNonBlockingGaps.verification: Parse the remaining GList setup tail or compare a Creator preview with a matched original capture; the outer 730x529 container and 100x100 cell size are already confirmed.
Record or capture the original level 1001 at a named phase, round, and elapsed timestamp.
Recover and map the representative level's sound, hit, skill, and result effects after the visual baseline is accepted.
